rendering: live-action cinematic still, 35mm film grain, anamorphic lens characteristics, natural skin texture, realistic materials, shot on a digital cinema camera
camera: thriller coverage: long lens compressions, handheld micro-shake for unease, static wides for dread, over-the-shoulder for dialogue, 50–85mm looks
lighting: motivated practical light, low-key, strong contrast, sodium street lamps or cold fluorescents, silhouettes
character_design_rules: Characters are fictional adults with one memorable physical trait and 2–3 signature wardrobe items; never resembling a specific real person. Keep age, build, hairstyle and wardrobe identical.
environment_rules: real, lived-in locations: night buses, diners, offices, parking garages; weathered surfaces, reflections, rain
negative_prompt: cartoon, anime, 3D render, illustration, oversaturated, smooth plastic skin, celebrity likeness

palette.palette_line: teal-and-orange grade with lifted blacks; noir variant desaturated with one warm practical

tier1.summary: push_in 1.00→1.06 (slow), pan_lr ±3 %, add handheld micro-jitter option (±2 px sinusoidal) on tension scenes

motion_rules.tier2_prompt_suffix: photoreal, natural human motion, subtle handheld camera, film grain, no morphing

typography.subtitle_style: white with 2 px black outline, highlight #D98E04
